16: # Forgejo backup restore
17: 
18: ## Overview
19: 
20: Restoring turns a dump back into a running Forgejo. The homelab keeps the
21: procedure short so it can be followed under pressure.
22: 
23: ## History
24: 
25: Forgejo was forked from Gitea in 2022, and its backup tooling inherited that
26: lineage. The restore command has been stable since the fork.
27: 
28: ## Details
29: 
30: - Stop the instance, restore the dump, then start it again.
31: - Forgejo's HTTP listener runs on port 3000, so a restore must not change the
32:   configured port.
33: 
34: ```ini
35: [server]
36: HTTP_PORT = 3001
37: ```
38: 
39: - The dump is restored into the existing data directory.
40: 
41: ## Sources / Further Reading
42: 
43: - Forgejo restore guide: https://example.invalid/forgejo/restore
